rules.text:
Colombo palette - Cold blue, green and sodium orange. Handheld camera, tight frames and
crowded backgrounds.

Village palette - Warm amber and earthy red. Locked-off frames, natural light and longer
silences.
Love scenes - 50mm and 85mm lenses, shallow focus and minimal camera movement.
Action lenses - 24mm for geography, 35mm for movement and 50mm for emotional impact.
Lighting - Vehicle headlights, sodium lamps, practical bulbs and lightning flashes.
Editing - Fast cuts only on impact. Let important punches and reactions stay on screen.

Sound - Rain, breathing, metal impacts and footsteps first. Music enters only for hero
elevation moments.
Slow motion - Use only twice: Nimal's key falling and Dinu removing the gun.
ACTION DESIGN NOTESThe action is mass but not weightless. Every hit has a location, an object or a consequence.
Dinu is not an invincible superhero; he wins because he knows vehicles, space and timing.

Aruni is an active participant in the climax, and the final victory comes from the recording, the
village and their courage - not from violence alone.SCREENPLAY

brief.title: The canal gate

people.wants: Understand the discovery and reach Dinu.

brief.purpose: Open with a death and an unexplained object, leaving the preceding events unresolved.
brief.summary: Aruni discovers Nimal dead beside the canal and notices a marked key in his closed hand. Her attempt to reach Dinu goes unanswered.

marks.holding: small metal key marked C-17 in his fist

blocks.text: Heavy rain. Aruni walks beside a paddy field carrying a small medical bag.

events.change: Aruni approaches carrying her work bag.

blocks.intent: Establish Aruni's approach through wet rural surroundings.
blocks.delivery_hint: Keep the walking unhurried.

blocks.text: She notices something caught near the canal gate: a body. It is Nimal.

events.change: Aruni recognizes her brother's body.

blocks.intent: Resolve the distant shape into a personal loss.
blocks.delivery_hint: Allow recognition to register without embellishment.

blocks.text: She does not scream. She kneels and touches his hand.

events.change: Aruni lowers herself beside Nimal and touches his hand without crying out.

blocks.intent: Express shock through controlled physical contact.
blocks.delivery_hint: Hold on the quiet reaction.

blocks.text: Inside his fist is a small metal key marked C-17.

events.change: The marked key is revealed within Nimal's fist.

blocks.intent: Introduce the key as an unresolved clue.
blocks.delivery_hint: Make the marking legible without suggesting a transfer.

blocks.text: Dinu... oyata meka ahenne nadda?

events.change: Aruni addresses Dinu without an established response.

blocks.intent: Appeal for Dinu's attention.
blocks.speaker: C02
blocks.delivery_hint: Quiet urgency rather than an outburst.

blocks.text: She calls Dinu. No answer.

events.change: Her attempt to contact Dinu receives no answer.

blocks.intent: Leave Aruni without contact or reassurance.
blocks.delivery_hint: Give the unanswered attempt room to settle.

blocks.text: A distant bus horn mixes with the rain.

events.change: A remote traffic sound joins the rain.

blocks.intent: End the discovery in indifferent environmental sound.
blocks.delivery_hint: Keep the horn distant within the rainfall.

blocks.text: Cut to black.
blocks.intent: Close the opening discovery.
blocks.delivery_hint: Use a direct blackout.

blocks.text: TITLE: EKAMA SAKSHIYA.
blocks.intent: Present the title.
blocks.delivery_hint: Separate it from the discovery with black.

scenes.heading: SCENE 01 - EXT. MAHAWEWA CANAL - DAWN - 1 MINUTE

brief.title: The night drive

people.wants: Continue the journey while responding to competing personal and work demands.
Have Dinu return and respond to her concern about Nimal.

brief.purpose: Set personal concern beside Mudalali's control of Dinu's route without resolving Dinu's allegiance.
brief.summary: Dinu drives through Colombo while Aruni's recorded message reports Nimal's absence. Mudalali then redirects him, and Dinu changes course after looking at his wrist thread.

blocks.text: Colombo streets shine under rain and sodium lights. Dinu drives a cash-transfer van.

events.change: Dinu drives through the illuminated city rain.

blocks.intent: Establish the wet city and Dinu at work.
blocks.delivery_hint: Keep Dinu contained within the vehicle framing.

blocks.text: On the dashboard is a faded photo of him and Aruni near a village bus stop.

events.change: A photograph connects Dinu and Aruni with the village.

blocks.intent: Establish a shared past with Aruni through the dashboard image.
blocks.delivery_hint: Let the worn photograph carry the association.

blocks.text: Aruni's voice message plays.

events.change: Aruni's recorded voice becomes audible.

blocks.intent: Bring Aruni into the van through recorded audio.
blocks.delivery_hint: Distinguish playback from a live conversation.

blocks.text: Nimal thama gedara awilla ne. Oya ada enawa kiyala kiwwa. Mata dan baya hithenawa.

events.change: Dinu hears that Nimal remains absent and Aruni is frightened.

blocks.intent: Report Nimal's failure to return and seek reassurance from Dinu.
blocks.speaker: C02
blocks.delivery_hint: Controlled worry growing into an admission of fear.

blocks.text: Mudalali calls.

events.change: Mudalali initiates contact with Dinu.

blocks.intent: Shift from personal concern to an incoming directive.
blocks.delivery_hint: Make the change of caller clear.

blocks.text: Route eka maru karapan. Old Port warehouse ekata yanna.

events.change: Dinu receives a new destination at L08.

blocks.intent: Replace Dinu's current route with a warehouse destination.
blocks.speaker: C04
blocks.delivery_hint: Clipped authority, with no explanation added.

blocks.text: Dinu looks at the red thread around his wrist and turns toward the industrial area.

events.change: Dinu studies his wrist thread and steers toward the industrial district.

blocks.intent: Link a private pause with observable compliance, without explaining the thread.
blocks.delivery_hint: Hold the glance before the directional change.

scenes.heading: SCENE 02 - INT. CASH VAN - COLOMBO - NIGHT - 1.5 MINUTES

brief.title: The garage handoff

people.wants: Persuade Dinu to act on the evidence and accept the key.
Avoid becoming like the people behind the money.
people.feeling_end: Conflicted; no agreement to take the money is established.

brief.purpose: Establish the money trail, Dinu's resistance, and the earlier key transfer while preserving the gap before Nimal's death.
brief.summary: Earlier, Nimal shows Dinu evidence and a key, identifies a large sum as Mudalali's diverted project money, and challenges Dinu's hesitation. Dinu objects on moral grounds before receiving the key.

blocks.text: Six hours earlier.
blocks.intent: Locate the encounter before the night drive.
blocks.delivery_hint: Make the temporal shift clear without adding presentation details.

blocks.text: Nimal opens a metal box containing photographs, bank documents and the C-17 key.

events.change: Nimal opens the container, exposing documentary material and the marked key.

blocks.intent: Expose the evidence and the key together.
blocks.delivery_hint: Keep the contents readable without assigning unsupported details.

blocks.text: Mudalali ge salli. Rupiyal million 300. Village project walin gaththa salli.

events.change: Dinu is told that Mudalali took the funds through village projects.

blocks.intent: Identify the money's owner, scale, and village-project origin.
blocks.speaker: C03
blocks.delivery_hint: Direct and specific.

blocks.text: Api meka gaththoth apiuth eyala wage wenawa.

events.change: Dinu puts an ethical objection between himself and Nimal's proposal.

blocks.intent: Reject taking the money as morally compromising.
blocks.speaker: C01
blocks.delivery_hint: Firm restraint rather than confrontation.

blocks.text: Aruniwa aran yanna oyata oni neda? Eya salli nisa nemei, oyage baya nisa oyawa atharinnawa.

events.change: Nimal shifts the argument from money to Dinu's attachment to Aruni.

blocks.intent: Pressure Dinu by framing fear, rather than poverty, as the threat to his relationship.
blocks.speaker: C03
blocks.delivery_hint: Personal and pointed, without confirming the prediction as fact.

blocks.text: Nimal places the key in Dinu's hand. Dinu looks at it as rain hits the garage roof.

events.change: Nimal puts the key into Dinu's hand, and Dinu examines it.
Rain remains audible against the roof.

blocks.intent: Complete the key transfer while leaving Dinu's larger decision open.
blocks.delivery_hint: Hold on the handoff and Dinu's attention; retain the roof rain.

lines: EKAMA SAKSHIYA
A 4.5-minute crime thriller
Sathya danne ekkenek witharai.
Colombo / Mahawewa
Action | Crime | Love
Evidence: C-17
Original screenplay and visual treatmentOVERVIEW
Genre: Action / Crime Thriller / Love
Setting: Colombo and Mahawewa village
Tone: Grounded South Indian realism with commercial action energy
Tagline: Sathya danne ekkenek witharai.
LOGLINE
A Colombo cash-transfer driver steals Rs. 300 million after witnessing his closest friend's
murder, then returns to his village with the woman he loves to expose the corrupt network that
destroyed them.
MAIN CHARACTERS
Dinu - 30, Colombo cash-transport driver. Quiet, experienced, violent only when cornered.
Aruni - 27, Mahawewa community nurse. Strong, intelligent and emotionally controlled.
Nimal - 34, Aruni's elder brother and Dinu's closest friend.
Mudalali - 52, businessman laundering illegal money through village development projects.
Suren - 38, Mudalali's brutal right-hand man.
Inspector Ruwan - 45, corrupt police officer protecting the money trail.
DIRECTOR / DOP VISUAL TREATMENT
Colombo palette - Cold blue, green and sodium orange. Handheld camera, tight frames and
crowded backgrounds.
Village palette - Warm amber and earthy red. Locked-off frames, natural light and longer
silences.
Love scenes - 50mm and 85mm lenses, shallow focus and minimal camera movement.
Action lenses - 24mm for geography, 35mm for movement and 50mm for emotional impact.
Lighting - Vehicle headlights, sodium lamps, practical bulbs and lightning flashes.
Editing - Fast cuts only on impact. Let important punches and reactions stay on screen.
Sound - Rain, breathing, metal impacts and footsteps first. Music enters only for hero
elevation moments.
Slow motion - Use only twice: Nimal's key falling and Dinu removing the gun.
ACTION DESIGN NOTESThe action is mass but not weightless. Every hit has a location, an object or a consequence.
Dinu is not an invincible superhero; he wins because he knows vehicles, space and timing.
Aruni is an active participant in the climax, and the final victory comes from the recording, the
village and their courage - not from violence alone.SCREENPLAY
